Job Title: Python Backend Developer

About Us
We build enterprise software products for global customers.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Python Backend Developer to design, develop and maintain scalable software systems.

Responsibilities
- Develop production software
- Build and maintain REST APIs
- Participate in code reviews
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams
- Write unit tests

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
- Strong communication skills

Python, SQL, REST APIs

Preferred Skills
Docker, AWS

Tools
Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman

Experience
2-4 years

Hybrid

Location
Chennai
